snippet.title: Don Bradman Cricket Jr - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Don Bradman Cricket Jr is the hard-hitting arcade cricket game — fast, accessible, easy to learn and rewarding to master. 

WISHLIST NOW:

Nintendo Switch → 
PlayStation 5 & 4 → https://store.playstation.com/en-au/concept/10020330
Xbox Series X|S & Xbox One → https://www.xbox.com/en-AU/games/store/don-bradman-cricket-jr/9p98bglbm4g6
PC (Steam) → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319470/Don_Bradman_Cricket_Jr/


FAST. FUN. CRICKET!


What's in the game:
• Quick Match, Tournaments and Challenges that teach you the basics
• Local 2-player split screen — take on your mates or the family on one screen
• Control the bat yourself: timing, power and placement decide where the ball goes
• Bowl with line, length, pace and spin, and set your own field
• 20 generic international teams
• Complete the Bradman Challenge Round to unlock Sir Donald Bradman
• Bradman vs Water Tank mini game: one stump, one ball, one water tank


Subscribe for more Don Bradman Cricket JR before launch.


Published by Tru Blu Games.
